templates.notes: BRD is a different document genre (business/product doc, not internal governance/legal doc) with its own 13-section structure and OBJ/BR/RULE/UC/ACT/AC traceability ID scheme, owned by the brd-generation skill. Registered here only so template PATH resolution stays unified across all SBSI document types; brd-generation still owns BRD's content workflow and section rules. KNOWN DISCREPANCY (verified against the real file): the BRD template's own ordinary text is Times New Roman 12pt with no real outline-level headings, not the 13pt/real-heading standard sbsi-docx-format-core enforces for governance documents — this is BRD's own long-standing convention, not a bug. Do not run normalize_ordinary_text.py against BRD output or treat the format-core validator's Fonts/Headings findings as blocking for BRD; see brd-generation/SKILL.md's 'Relationship to sbsi-template-router' section.
